calls.statement:
WITH q1 AS (
  SELECT d_start.period_start_date AS start_date, d_end.period_end_date AS end_date
  FROM (SELECT min(period_start_date) period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_quarter=1) d_start,
       (SELECT max(period_end_date) period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_quarter=1) d_end
), sold AS (
  SELECT p.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_sold,
         sum(coalesce(r.quantity_returned,0)) AS units_returned, sum(coalesce(r.refund_net,0)) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
  CROSS JOIN q1
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN q1.start_date AND q1.end_date AND p.category = 'Garden'
  GROUP BY p.subcategory
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, subcategory, units_sold, units_returned,
       round(100.0 * units_returned / units_sold, 2) AS return_rate_pct_units,
       round(100.0 * refund_net / net_sold, 2) AS return_rate_pct_value
FROM sold ORDER BY subcategory
